request.style: English, male solo voice, warm and reverent, acoustic guitar, piano, strings, soft drums, peaceful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sons of Uzziel stand in the line
Mishael and Elzaphan and Sithri
From the household of Kohath they came
Levites chosen to bear the name

[Chorus]
They camp on the south side of the tent
Guarding the holy things that the Lord sent
The ark and the table and the lampstand bright
They carry the work of the sanctuary night and day

[Verse]
When fire came from before the Lord
And consumed Nadab and Abihu
Moses called the sons of Uzziel
Come carry them out from the camp

[Chorus]
They camp on the south side of the tent
Guarding the holy things that the Lord sent
The ark and the table and the lampstand bright
They carry the work of the sanctuary night and day

[Bridge]
Among those who draw near to me
I will show myself holy says the Lord
Before all the people I am glorified
In silence Aaron stands before God

[Outro]
Eight thousand six hundred men
Charged with the care of the holy things
A gift to Aaron and his sons
To guard the priesthood of Israel
